counterfactual_missing_items: congophilic amorphous eosinophilic deposits in dermal papillae
decisive_items: Revealed a circumscribed tumor contiguous with adjoining normal epidermis and delineated from underlying dermis by continuous apocrine epithelial lining
Tumor epithelium with multiple papillary projections with vascular, plasma cell–rich stroma
p63 staining positive in myoepithelial cell layers
response.rationale: R2 is supported by multiple specific histopathologic and immunohistochemical features (apocrine epithelial lining, papillary projections, p63-positive myoepithelial cells) that directly define hidradenoma papilliferum. R5 only cites the congophilic deposits, which are a secondary finding and not the primary tumor diagnosis. R1 relies solely on childhood duration, which is nonspecific and contradicted by the histology showing a circumscribed apocrine tumor.

rejected.why: Only childhood history is cited; histopathology shows an apocrine tumor with papillary projections and myoepithelial staining, incompatible with nevus sebaceus.
